name: G-VAMS-ERP
description: Workspace root for the packages/ tree (@oram/core, @oram/events, @oram/runtime, @oram/engines, @oram/cli, ...). Enables `npm install` to resolve @oram/* cross-package imports as real workspace symlinks -- see packages/cli/README.md and docs/presentation/README-demo.md for the resulting `oram analyze` dev-mode command. Does not affect backend/ or frontend/ (the existing G-VAMS application), which remain their own independent npm projects.
